messages.content: I’ll buy DA energy in HE09 at $12.23/MWh and sell it in HE20 at $37.44/MWh. That gives about $221.53 after charging losses if the battery follows the plan. I’ll reassess the physical schedule as RT prices and notices arrive.
The battery is fully charged at 10 MWh. No new notices or derates have arrived, and the settled RT prices so far don’t justify changing the planned HE20 discharge.
